description: Example dashboard for the wilsonwaters-webview-app plugin. Panel 1 shows Direct mode (renders in-panel). Panel 2 shows Proxy mode, which requires an admin to allowlist the target domain first and currently displays the documented fallback (see issue #102).

options.content:
# Web View plugin — example dashboard

- **Direct mode** (left) renders an external page straight inside the panel; no backend or allowlist needed.
- **Proxy mode** (right) routes a framing-blocked page through the backend proxy. It requires an administrator to **allowlist the target domain first** (the allowlist is empty/deny-all by default), and in-panel proxy rendering is deferred for v1 (issue #102), so this panel shows the documented fallback.

See `docs/examples/README.md` and `docs/administration.md` for the allowlist prerequisite.

panels.title: Direct mode — renders in-panel
panels.description: A framable URL loaded with loadMode 'direct'. This panel renders the external page directly inside the panel and needs no backend or allowlist.

panels.title: Proxy mode — requires allowlisting (shows fallback in v1)
panels.description: A URL loaded with loadMode 'proxy'. An administrator must allowlist example.org before the proxy will serve it (the allowlist is deny-all by default). In-panel proxy rendering is deferred for v1 (issue #102), so this panel displays the documented fallback rather than the proxied page.
